description: Search for stops/stations by name. Returns matches with a naptanId (the "id" field) used by the arrivals tool, plus modes, zone, and lat/lon.

modes.description: Optional filter. Comma-separated transport modes: tube, dlr, overground, elizabeth-line, bus, tram, national-rail.

query.description: Stop/station name to search for, e.g. "Oxford Circus".

name: stop_search
title: Stop Search
